# Statistical methods {#sec-statistical-methods}

This chapter starts with a review of the theory behind
Bayesian parameter estimation, including a detailed description 
of a commonly used diagnostic tool: the $p$-$p$ plot (@sec-pp-plot)

Then, we provide a description of the main
statistical methods used to perform state-of-the-art parameter 
estimation for gravitational waves, including Nested Sampling 
(@sec-nested-sampling) and Neural Posterior Estimation (@sec-neural-posterior-estimation).
